name: 张鲁
versionPolicy: Current official hero343, official API and current public client character343 with exact YiShe259/BuShi260/MiDao261 text. No historical rice-stock condition or cross-product edition is imported.

sources.role: older official same-text introduction; no added historical rule

currentClient.comparison: All three exact current client descriptions equal hero343 after whitespace normalization. h=1 is male; g=4 is Qun; i=3 matches API hp. j/k/l establish complete skill identity, not the order of textual names guessed from older guide.

officialSkillText.YiShe: 结束阶段，若你没有“米”，你可以摸两张牌，然后将两张牌置于你的武将牌上，称为“米”。当你失去最后一张“米”时，你回复1点体力。
officialSkillText.BuShi: 当你受到1点伤害后，你可以获得一张“米”。当你对其他角色造成1点伤害后，其可以获得一张“米”。
officialSkillText.MiDao: 当一张判定牌生效前，你可以用一张“米”代替之。

interpretations: Unqualified owned cards for Yishe storage means Hand or Equipment; actual own transfer legality and movement children remain enforced. If fewer than two eligible owned cards remain after actual draw children, store all remaining eligible cards.

Bushi incoming and outgoing opportunities are per actual applied damage point; self-inflicted sourced damage has incoming only and source-less damage can have incoming. For outgoing other damage, the damaged character controls optional confirmation and exact rice selection.
Exhaustion recovery uses frozen exact producer pile before/after counts of one actual movement batch, not a live global card count or another public pile belonging to the same owner.

Midao replaces from the exact rice location through Processing into the existing real Judgment frame, discards the old judgment, and drains last-rice recovery children before advancing that judgment candidate.

Already-issued draw and transfer receipts drain their children without repaying. Genuine removal of the Yishe producer clears its pile via existing source cleanup and does not resurrect that source; temporary suppression retains the actual stored rice.
